name: Team Manager Unified
author: polyxgo

sections.description:
Manage branch, department, position, and staff information. Supports displaying employee details, department structure, and branches. Automatically supports schema.org, including both Microdata and LD-JSON, and more.

Thank you for your interest and use of Team Manager Unified plugin! Feedback, suggestions, and reviews are motivation to keep improving, integrating, and developing new features. If you need help with conflict resolution, feature adjustments, or have new feature ideas, feel free to share your thoughts with me!

Core Features

  • Create and manage branch and office lists, including contact details and addresses.
  • Create and manage department lists by branch or office.
  • Create and manage position and role lists by department.
  • Create and manage staff lists by department, including contact info, phone, email, socials, etc.
  • Display staff information list.

Upcoming Features

  • Templates for displaying profiles, staff information, and related articles on site.
  • Support for displaying organizational charts and staff structure by branch and department.
  • Display department-specific staff charts, allowing targeted personnel display on relevant landing pages.
  • Support for assigning diverse display templates, showcasing organizational structure and company professionalism.

Support

For support, please visit https://wikipoly.com/en/team-manager-unified
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater is required (PHP 8.0 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater, OR MariaDB version 10.1 or greater, is required
  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/team-manager-unified directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress. Then, in the display section for plugins, themes, categories, tags, etc., you will see a pin button next to its name.
  3. Use the Team Manager Unified screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Refer to the feature guide list here: https://wikipoly.com/en/team-manager-unified
sections.faq:
Where to find help?

  • First-time users should read https://wikipoly.com/en/team-manager-unified, which explains the basics and includes a lot of screenshots and shortcodes.

  • Update to the new plugin version at: https://wikipoly.com/en/team-manager-unified and WordPress.org (https://wordpress.org/plugins/team-manager-unified), where we share and provide free support or sell our products.

How to display staff list?

  • Use [team_manager_unified_staff] to display staff list.

Does plugin support UX Builder?

  • Yes, plugin currently supports integration with popular builders such as Flatsome (UX Builder), Elementor, and more.

Can staff info display on posts be toggled on or off?

  • Yes, by default, staff info for authors is shown below each post. To disable this feature, go to Team Manager Unified / Settings / Uncheck Enable staff info display as post author.
